interface.shortDescription: Turn agent work into a short, narrated proof video — every beat backed by real commits, PRs, and diffs.
interface.longDescription: Keris turns what your coding agent just shipped into a short, narrated video — a receipt, not a recap. Every generated proof is grounded in real commits, PRs, diffs, and bounded evidence through the Keris GitHub app, so reviewers can trust what they are watching. Use generate_video for proof-bound agent work, then share a stable keris.video watch link your team can keep up with.
